description: We're a team of 6 talented students from SOU "Jane Sandanski" - Strumica. Our goal is to make an easily accessible website that offers countless of NASA's data that has been gathered from NASA’s SPHEREx mission - while making it equally understandable and fun to use for all audiences.
summary:
We are “To The Skies” — a team of six students from SOU “Jane Sandanski” Strumica.
We’ve taken on the challenge PlanetX & SPHEREx, and developed an accessible and interactive web tool to access captures from the databases of NASA’s SPHEREx mission.
Our website is understandable and easy to use, taking into account that there are countless captures from this 27-month mission, and it’s nearly impossible for just one person to comb through.
details: We have made a website with the goal of making NASA's job of tracking astronomical objects' movement easier and also making NASA's newest telescope data more accessible to the average man. This project will benefit NASA by expanding its knowledge on satellite's' movement. The tools used for making this are: a VPS from vultr, a domain name from porkbun; the programming languages: Python, Go and JavaScript. We also used NASA's data from the SPHEREx telescope. The factor we most considered was cost, as we are on a tight budget.
